"""Temporal candidate policy with safety gating, stable reacquisition, and
hysteresis-based movement selection."""

# EVOLVE-BLOCK-START
MOTION_ACTIONS = ("FORWARD", "VEER_LEFT", "VEER_RIGHT")


def safety_contract(observation, memory):
    """Stop when confidence is weak or collision-closing risk is excessive."""
    if (
        float(observation["safety_confidence"]) < 0.60
        or float(observation["closing_risk"]) >= 0.75
    ):
        memory["state"] = "STOPPED"
        memory["last_action"] = "STOP"
        return "STOP", 0.99
    return None


def tracking_contract(observation, memory):
    """Verify a stable target and use bounded stopping before alternating scans."""
    visible = bool(observation["target_visible"])
    reliable = (
        visible
        and float(observation["target_confidence"]) >= 0.55
        and float(observation["target_identity_confidence"]) >= 0.60
    )
    if not reliable:
        lost_steps = max(0, int(observation["lost_steps"]))
        prior = memory.get("state")
        if prior in {"LOCKED", "APPROACH", "REACQUIRE", "VERIFY"} and lost_steps <= 2:
            memory["state"] = "REACQUIRE"
            memory["last_action"] = "STOP"
            return "STOP", 0.93
        direction = "SCAN_LEFT" if lost_steps % 2 == 0 else "SCAN_RIGHT"
        memory["state"] = "SEARCH"
        memory["scan_direction"] = direction
        memory["last_action"] = direction
        return direction, 0.76
    if int(observation["track_age"]) < 2:
        memory["state"] = "VERIFY"
        memory["last_action"] = "SLOW_DOWN"
        return "SLOW_DOWN", 0.80
    return None


def propose_moves(observation, memory):
    """Build deduplicated moves from bearing and currently open corridors."""
    bearing = float(observation["target_bearing"])
    heading = float(observation["heading_error"])
    candidates = []
    if bearing < -12.0 and bool(observation["corridor_left"]):
        candidates.append("VEER_LEFT")
    if bearing > 12.0 and bool(observation["corridor_right"]):
        candidates.append("VEER_RIGHT")
    if bool(observation["corridor_center"]):
        candidates.append("FORWARD")
    if bool(observation["corridor_left"]):
        candidates.append("VEER_LEFT")
    if bool(observation["corridor_right"]):
        candidates.append("VEER_RIGHT")
    if abs(heading) <= 10.0 and bool(observation["corridor_center"]):
        candidates.insert(0, "FORWARD")
    return list(dict.fromkeys(candidates))


def progress_contract(observation, memory, candidates):
    """Prefer aligned forward travel and suppress immediate left-right reversals."""
    if not candidates:
        return None
    heading = float(observation["heading_error"])
    bearing = float(observation["target_bearing"])
    previous = memory.get("last_action")
    if "FORWARD" in candidates and abs(heading) <= 12.0 and abs(bearing) <= 18.0:
        choice = "FORWARD"
    elif bearing < -8.0 and "VEER_LEFT" in candidates:
        choice = "VEER_LEFT"
    elif bearing > 8.0 and "VEER_RIGHT" in candidates:
        choice = "VEER_RIGHT"
    else:
        choice = candidates[0]
    if (
        previous == "VEER_LEFT"
        and choice == "VEER_RIGHT"
        and abs(bearing) < 20.0
        and "FORWARD" in candidates
    ):
        choice = "FORWARD"
    elif (
        previous == "VEER_RIGHT"
        and choice == "VEER_LEFT"
        and abs(bearing) < 20.0
        and "FORWARD" in candidates
    ):
        choice = "FORWARD"
    memory["last_action"] = choice
    return choice


def termination_contract(observation, memory):
    """Return a high-confidence stationary fallback when no move is admissible."""
    memory["state"] = "STOPPED"
    memory["last_action"] = "STOP"
    return "STOP", 0.98


def decide(observation, memory):
    """Apply safety, tracking, arrival, progress, and termination in fixed order."""
    memory = dict(memory or {})
    safety = safety_contract(observation, memory)
    if safety is not None:
        return safety[0], safety[1], memory

    tracking = tracking_contract(observation, memory)
    if tracking is not None:
        return tracking[0], tracking[1], memory

    memory["state"] = "LOCKED"
    near = observation["target_distance_class"] == "near"
    heading = float(observation["heading_error"])
    identity = float(observation["target_identity_confidence"])

    if near and abs(heading) <= 15.0 and identity >= 0.80:
        memory["state"] = "ARRIVED"
        memory["last_action"] = "ARRIVED"
        return "ARRIVED", 0.96, memory

    if near:
        if bool(observation["corridor_center"]) and abs(heading) <= 25.0:
            candidates = ["FORWARD"]
        elif float(observation["target_bearing"]) < 0.0:
            candidates = ["VEER_LEFT"] if bool(observation["corridor_left"]) else []
        else:
            candidates = ["VEER_RIGHT"] if bool(observation["corridor_right"]) else []
    else:
        candidates = propose_moves(observation, memory)

    action = progress_contract(observation, memory, candidates)
    if action is None:
        fallback = termination_contract(observation, memory)
        return fallback[0], fallback[1], memory

    memory["state"] = "APPROACH"
    return action, 0.90, memory


# EVOLVE-BLOCK-END
